description: Figure 9 presents a bar chart illustrating the performance scores of different language models across several datasets and metrics. The horizontal axis represents the dataset and metric, labeled as “Dataset and Metrics,” with categories including GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LLaMA-Eval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard, listed in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Score (%)”, displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals.  There are two sets of bars for each dataset: one representing “LLaMA-3-8B-it” (in blue) and the other representing “Ours (iterative RLHF)” (in orange). For GSM-8K, the “LLaMA-3-8B-it” score is approximately 48%, while “Ours (iterative RLHF)” achieves a score of approximately 68%.  Across all datasets, the “Ours (iterative RLHF)” bars are consistently taller than the corresponding “LLaMA-3-8B-it” bars. The bars are arranged in pairs, grouped by dataset, with the “LLaMA-3-8B-it” bar appearing first, followed by the “Ours (iterative RLHF)” bar. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
